chapters.title: A name
chapters.body: Louma is Milla's sister. The bakery carries her name, and a promise.
chapters.alt: Croissants on a wire rack, one torn open to show its layers

chapters.title: An idea
chapters.body: Build a real bakery with honest bread, and staff it in a way most places say can't be done.
chapters.alt: Pain au chocolat and almond croissants cooling on a wire rack

chapters.title: A team
chapters.body: Bakers and trainers, many with intellectual or developmental differences, learning the craft together.
chapters.alt: A speed rack loaded with seeded pastries, pain au chocolat, and sliced cake

chapters.title: A corner on Wilshire
chapters.body: A small room with a big oven, and a door with a face on it.
chapters.alt: The bakery's glass front door between concrete columns, with red chairs outside
